name: @spell-app/epics
description: Plan docs and every docs page's tooling:  the <epic-*> component pack a page loads on demand through <ui-root> (spell dev pack), the plan-doc tool, and the docs tools (tools/) with the assets every docs page loads

scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
scripts.ts:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TSC' && tsc && tsc -p ../../tests/epics && echo '<< TSC PASSED
'
scripts.lint:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT' && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src components scripts tools && cd ../../tests/epics && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 . && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.lint:fix:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT --fix' && vp lint --fix src components scripts tools && cd ../../tests/epics && vp lint --fix . && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.format:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> FORMATTING WITH OXFMT' && vp fmt src components scripts tools vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts && cd ../../tests/epics && vp fmt . && echo '<< OXFMT PASSED
'
scripts.test:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TESTS' && vp test run && echo '<< TESTS PASSED
'
